value.rationale: This is the smallest nontrivial squared Grassmannian and a basic projection-DPP model. The result replaces an undifferentiated quartic boundary by an exact geometric stratification into eleven natural surfaces, identifies the uniform generic transverse singularity, proves normality, and explains the strata through the finite sign quotient. These data are structural and reusable in local, quotient, and statistical geometry rather than a numerical recomputation.
